# 8-bit WavPack fixture (#4120)

Generated on Shrek with Python wave/math and WavPack 5.6.0 (Ubuntu package
5.6.0-1build1). Original synthetic signal, no recording or third-party content.

4410 unsigned 8-bit mono samples at 44100 Hz:
    round(128 + 80 * sin(2 * pi * 441 * n / 44100)), n = 0..4409

Write a PCM WAV with Python wave (sampwidth=1, channels=1, framerate=44100),
then run wavpack -q sine8.wav -o mono_8_44100.wv.

Expected streaming PCM: each original WAV byte v becomes signed i16
(v - 128) * 256. MD5 of these values sign-extended to little-endian i32:
d403bd7ea1f5daccac3cc5961c51e7fa
